verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a first-party doc page on testing verification errors. It says you can force failing verification checks to test error-handling flows, which implies a test capability, but never describes a separate sandbox or test environment isolated from production data. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a sandbox/test environment and test credentials, a statement that it is isolated from production data, coverage of simulating card transactions and authorisations in test, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: To test your error handling flow, you can force a scenario where one or more verification checks fail.
